findings.summary: 判据 4b / spec §0 preserved list require `MAX_CLUES` to be profile-declared so the regression's research scope is narrowed (⛔ 不得回退). No MAX_CLUES key exists in the delivered regression profile, no code path reads such an env, and DEFAULT_TICK_CONFIG.maxClues stays at 64 (src/tick.ts:87). Nothing in this delivery narrows the regression scope, so 判据 6's demand that the profile's declared 2400s wall clock be self-consistent with reaching a non-null termination is also unaddressed.

spec §1.1 forbids picking node_timeout by feel and requires the previously delivered `timings` per-stage instrumentation to produce a measured p95/max single-tick duration justifying the value; §1.1b (retained item) likewise requires stage-by-stage evidence of where the 30 seconds went. There is no `timings` instrumentation anywhere in src/ (the string only occurs in the spec), and no measured p95/max is recorded in the delivery. The value 600 is justified only by GT-18's kill times (30.5–39.9s, i.e. the old ceiling, not completion times) plus alignment with a TICK_TIMEOUT_MS that is not declared in this tree.

判据 2b (GT-15/GT-16 regression) is not implemented: no test drives a real `--run` on a seed board (1 clue) and asserts the elapsed time is below half the engine `node_timeout` with `termination` readable. No test in test/ measures tick duration at all, so reverting the §1.1 fix would leave the suite green.

判据 2a's discriminating test does not drive the subject under test. It asserts the byte offset of the literal "HIT WALL CLOCK LIMIT" precedes "HIT ATTEMPT LIMIT" in the shell source and does arithmetic on profile keys; it never constructs the required scenario (wall-clock budget remaining but attempt count exhausted ⇒ entry must continue). The repo already has a harness that really executes bin/e0-regression.sh with injected fake drains (setupE0RegressionEnv in test/e0c2-termination.test.ts:1049-1100), and that harness shows the entry still exits non-zero with HIT ATTEMPT LIMIT when attempts run out while wall clock remains — i.e. the behavior 判据 2a demands is neither implemented nor tested through the entry.

`limits.wall_clock: 60` is left unchanged in the same limits map while node_timeout is raised 30 → 600. If wall_clock is the run-level engine budget in seconds (the same units as node_timeout, and consistent with GT-15 where a 39.9s tick died on node_timeout:30), the effective engine ceiling for a tick remains 60s and the intended 600s headroom can never be reached. The delivery neither justifies leaving it at 60 nor asserts it in any test.

When a triage run exits without a result, the handler records a TriageReport with `budgetSkipped: true` — a false reason (no write budget was exhausted) that will misattribute the failure in the run record. §1.1c requires the affected work's status to truthfully reflect the failure, with the chosen in-repo semantics explained; here the batch is silently reported as a budget skip and the affected proposed clues get no failure-reflecting status.

The workflow.yaml rationale says 600 is chosen "与已声明的 TICK_TIMEOUT_MS 对齐", but TICK_TIMEOUT_MS is not declared anywhere in this tree (no profile, template, or source references it). The stated basis points at an artifact of the previous, rejected package.

判据 2z's test calls runChannelWrite directly and only asserts that diagnostics were populated; it does not assert the tick's exit code is 0 through tick-entry, nor that the remaining decisions still executed. The reverse case (bus unreachable ⇒ non-zero) is covered.
Unlike every prior package in this line, no docs/dev-notes entry was added for E0c7, so the measured evidence §1.1 asks for has no place in the delivery outside a YAML comment.
